groups.subject: HUMA/SOSC/SHSS
groups.note: HUMA/SOSC/SHSS Electives [Students opting for SHSS 4992 OR (SHSS 4991 AND SHSS 4993) are required to take a minimum total of 8 courses (24 credits), out of which 2 must be at 3000-/4000- level; students opting for SHSS 4991 are required to take a minimum total of 9 courses (27 credits), out of which 3 must be at 3000-/4000- level.] Students in the Integrated Humanities and Social Science Track with CGA of 3.3 or above may apply for enrollment in the Applied Economics Research Option.  In addition, they should take Honors Thesis or Honors Research with a primary focus in applied economics to complete the requirement of SHSS 4992 OR (SHSS 4991 AND SHSS 4993) as specified in the Major Requirements. Students may opt to graduate with or without an option.  Students who take an option MUST complete all requirements specified in addition to the major requirements.
